# ankra_node_groups (Data Source)

The node groups of a cluster Ankra provisioned, including the default worker group the cluster was created with. The counterpart of `ankra cluster node-group list`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_node_groups" "example" {
  cluster_id = "ef8cf93e-1d97-4494-9de4-12ced709ffde"
}

output "node_group_sizes" {
  value = { for group in data.ankra_node_groups.example.node_groups : group.name => group.count }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster to list.

### Read-Only

- `cluster_kind` (String) Kind of the cluster.
- `node_groups` (Attributes List) The cluster's node groups. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--node_groups))

<a id="nestedatt--node_groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `node_groups`

Read-Only:

- `autoscaling_enabled` (Boolean) Whether autoscaling is on.
- `count` (Number) Node count.
- `instance_type` (String) Instance type.
- `labels` (Map of String) Node labels.
- `max_count` (Number) Autoscaling upper bound.
- `min_count` (Number) Autoscaling lower bound.
- `name` (String) Group name.
